pages.title: How Select Your Sauna researches products
pages.description: The source, matching and limitation rules used for the US sauna research section.
pages.heading: What a documented sauna result means
introduction: Select Your Sauna organizes model-specific information so that dimensions, seating, placement and electrical details stay attached to the exact configuration they describe. The US section is a research project and is not a hands-on test, installation approval or checkout service.

sections.heading: Primary sources come first
paragraphs: Manufacturer product pages, manuals and specification sheets are used for core product facts. Retailer and affiliate pages can help identify an offer, but they do not replace a manufacturer source for a technical claim. Each documented value keeps a reference to the source record used for it.

sections.heading: A model family is not one universal specification
paragraphs: Size, placement, heat type, capacity and electrical requirements are checked at configuration level. A value from one size or package is not copied to another. When the sources disagree or leave a field open, the site keeps that uncertainty visible instead of turning it into a positive match.

sections.heading: The finder narrows a search; it does not approve an installation
paragraphs: A result means that the selected facts are documented or that a remaining question is shown for verification. Exterior dimensions do not include every required clearance, door swing, service area, route or local code condition. Electrical information should be checked against the instructions for the exact configuration and local requirements.

sections.heading: Corrections are welcome
paragraphs: If a source changes or a product record contains an error, please send the page address, the affected statement and the supporting source to info@selectyoursauna.com. The record can then be reviewed against the same source rules.

pages.title: Affiliate disclosure for Select Your Sauna
pages.description: How marked affiliate links, product selection and merchant relationships are handled in the US section.
pages.heading: How merchant links fit into the research
introduction: The US research section currently has no published affiliate offer. If a reviewed merchant relationship is activated later, the affected link will be marked before it leaves Select Your Sauna. A commission can be paid after a qualifying action, without changing the price shown by the merchant.

sections.heading: A marked link is the point of attribution
paragraphs: Awin or another approved network is contacted only when a visitor deliberately opens a marked outbound link. The page does not load a tracking request in the background. The network and merchant then apply their own attribution, privacy and retention rules.

sections.heading: Commission does not set the comparison result
paragraphs: Product inclusion, comparison scope and Finder logic are based on the documented product and configuration records. There are no paid rankings or claims of first-hand testing. A merchant link does not replace the source used for a technical statement.

sections.heading: Publication follows a separate approval gate
paragraphs: An affiliate link can be shown only after the program, merchant, exact configuration, destination, tracking URL, freshness and disclosure have all been reviewed. Until that gate is opened, the US pages remain without affiliate offers.

pages.title: Privacy information for Select Your Sauna
pages.description: The current website data flows, hosting services and external-link boundaries for the US research section.
pages.heading: What the website does with information
introduction: This notice describes the technical behavior of the public US research beta. Account settings, contract terms and jurisdiction-specific obligations are reviewed separately before search indexing or commercial features are enabled.

sections.heading: Operator and contact

sections.heading: Static delivery through Cloudflare
paragraphs: The site is exported as static HTML, CSS, images and JavaScript and delivered through Cloudflare. A request may include an IP address, time, host, path, query string, referrer, browser or system information and transfer metadata. Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled for the domain and can receive performance and visit measurements through Cloudflare's analytics service. The exact account products, retention settings and applicable transfer terms are controlled in the Cloudflare account.

sections.heading: Finder and catalog choices
paragraphs: Finder and catalog choices are processed in the browser. They are reflected in the visible URL so that a result can be refreshed or shared. The site does not send those choices to its own database, create an account or build a profile. A later request for a shared or reloaded URL can include its query parameters in hosting request handling.

sections.heading: Analytics, cookies and external links
paragraphs: The checked-in public client contains no first-party analytics SDK, advertising pixel, analytics cookie, local storage or session storage. External merchant, manufacturer and source sites are opened only after a visitor follows a link. An approved affiliate link may pass through a partner network, which then applies its own privacy and attribution rules.

sections.heading: Email contact
paragraphs: The site uses a mailto link rather than a website form. Any message, sender address, attachments and transmission metadata are handled by the email systems chosen by the sender and recipient. The actual mailbox routing and retention configuration must be documented by the operator.

sections.heading: Review when services change
paragraphs: This page must be updated when analytics, a consent tool, a contact form, accounts, personalization, server-side redirects, new embeds or a new hosting or affiliate service is introduced. Applicable rights, contact procedures, retention periods and transfer information also need renewed review when the service or intended audience changes.
